# Physio to Home

> Physio to Home provides professional in-home physiotherapy across Tasmania, Australia. AHPRA-registered physiotherapists deliver personalised assessment, treatment and rehabilitation in clients' homes, aged care facilities and workplaces — no GP referral required.

Physio to Home provides mobile physiotherapy across Tasmania, including metropolitan, regional and rural communities. Contact the team with your town or suburb to confirm visit availability. Services cover back, neck and joint pain, post-surgery rehabilitation, falls prevention, neurological rehabilitation, aged care physiotherapy, and chronic pain management.

Funding pathways may include Medicare GP Chronic Condition Management Plans (including eligible legacy GP Management Plans and Team Care Arrangements), DVA for eligible Veteran Card holders, NDIS (self-managed and plan-managed participants), My Aged Care Support at Home and CHSP, WorkCover where applicable, private health insurance, and private payment. Eligibility and approval requirements apply.

- [Home](https://www.physiotohome.com/): overview of services, coverage area and how to book
- [Services](https://www.physiotohome.com/services): full list of physiotherapy services offered
- [Team](https://www.physiotohome.com/team): AHPRA-registered physiotherapists on staff
- [Blog](https://www.physiotohome.com/blog): physiotherapy advice and health guides
- [Booking](https://www.physiotohome.com/booking): book an in-home appointment
- [Contact](https://www.physiotohome.com/contact): phone, email and contact form
